detailed_descriptions.en: Simulator of an 80s Japanese stock market businessman. Chill, catch a retro vibe and watch your profits grow in the text-based game STONKS-9800. Features: Buy stocks, get dividends, monitor the prices; Your decisions affect the market – and your life; Keep an eye on your health and do not overwork, lest you end up in the hospital; Invest in real estate and cars, increasing your level of comfort; Manage your company, having a controlling interest; Achieve success as a legal business – or get rich quickly engaging in shady activities; Play a variety of mini-games, including pachinko and horse racing betting Many other features and unexpected situations await you in STONKS-9800 .

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Simulator of an 80s Japanese stock market businessman. Chill, catch a retro vibe and watch your profits grow in the text-based game STONKS-9800.

Features:

  • Buy stocks, get dividends, monitor the prices;

  • Your decisions affect the market – and your life;

  • Keep an eye on your health and do not overwork, lest you end up in the hospital;

  • Invest in real estate and cars, increasing your level of comfort;

  • Manage your company, having a controlling interest;

  • Achieve success as a legal business – or get rich quickly engaging in shady activities;

  • Play a variety of mini-games, including pachinko and horse racing betting

  • Many other features and unexpected situations await you in STONKS-9800.
